note: Un plan = un clip à générer par le service vidéo IA. 'debut'/'fin' = minutage dans dialogue.wav. 'parle' = personnage dont la bouche doit être synchronisée sur ce plan.

plans.cadre: medium close-up, slow push-in to close-up
plans.action: Mohamed is slumped relaxed on the grey sofa, TV football in the background, checking his banking app on his phone with reading glasses. His face freezes, eyebrows shoot up, he leans toward the screen in disbelief, then turns his head toward the hallway and shouts.

plans.cadre: medium shot from the sofa, hallway door in the background
plans.action: Yanis walks into the living room scrolling on his phone, relaxed, shrugging innocently as he talks.
Mohamed angrily holds his phone screen out toward camera (toward Yanis), glasses down his nose, shouting.
Yanis caught out, raises both palms, nervous smile, steps back, talking fast trying to explain.
Adam sprawled on the other end of the sofa, headphones around his neck, phone in hand, laughing and pointing at his brother, teasing.
Yanis turns sharply toward Adam, pointing at him, annoyed; Adam keeps smirking.

plans.cadre: wide shot through the kitchen doorway, then quick push-in
plans.action: Nadia in her apron at the stove, wooden spoon in hand, turns toward the living room and shouts, exasperated, steam rising from the pots.

plans.cadre: close-up, she is half-hidden behind the display cabinet
plans.action: Ines, long dark hair, earbuds in, discreetly holds her phone up filming the argument, whispering with a mischievous grin, the red recording dot glowing on her screen.
Mohamed slowly stands up from the sofa, takes off his reading glasses, stern and calm, staring at Yanis.

plans.cadre: medium close-up, slight hero low angle
plans.action: Yanis puffs out his chest, hand on heart, proud and confident, like a businessman giving a pitch.

plans.cadre: quick tilt down to Yanis's brand-new chunky sneakers, then whip back up to Mohamed
plans.action: Mohamed points furiously at Yanis's brand-new sneakers and explodes, arms wide in outrage.
Adam bursts out laughing so hard he slides off the sofa onto the rug, holding his stomach.
Yanis defensive, gesturing with his phone, arguing that it is limited edition and an investment.

plans.cadre: close-up on Mohamed, deadpan, then cut to Yanis's face falling
plans.action: Mohamed, totally calm and deadpan, delivers the punishment slowly; Yanis's confident face collapses.

plans.cadre: wide shot of the whole living room
plans.action: Whole family in frame: Nadia in the kitchen doorway with her spoon shaking her head, Mohamed sits back down satisfied, Yanis drops onto the sofa defeated, Adam still laughing on the rug, Ines laughing as she taps 'post' on her phone. Hold on the laugh.
